---
name: Bounded study proposal
about: Specify a falsifiable target and decision rules before collecting outcomes
title: "[Study] "
---

Read [the study design](https://github.com/Unjuno/hbm-anomaly-research/blob/main/docs/study-design.md) before completing this proposal.

- Study identifier and dated plan version:
- Claim(s) being tested: physical excess / functional excess / cohort association / supply mechanism:
- Target SKU, PCI/subsystem IDs, board PN/revision, inclusion and exclusion rules:
- Bounded target set or production-stage date windows, date sources and controls:
- Exact nominal data-capacity baseline in bytes; source and GB/GiB interpretation:
- Minimum additional distinct bytes or other predeclared effect threshold; reason for choosing it:
- Evidence already known; distinguish exploratory and independent confirmation data:
- Intended owners/devices per group; acquisition provenance and possible shared donor stock:
- Environment, test version, device-residency controls, patterns, coverage, repetitions and duration:
- Separate PASS / FAIL / UNCERTAIN rules for each claim:
- Maximum sample count or collection deadline; stopping and amendment rules:
- Alternative explanations and observations that would distinguish them:
- Uncertainty, incomplete dates, missing metadata and untested ranges:
- Plan for retaining negative, uncertain and incomplete results:

Use anonymized sample identifiers. A proposal does not require buying or modifying hardware. An exploratory sample is not a representative prevalence estimate.
